modeling_decisions: Retain concept coarse open fold, thick contrasting mineral bands, chunky broken faces. Simplify photoreal microtexture into integrated angular coarse mineral facets. Use one closed surface mesh with folded full-depth foliation coordinates, physical differential erosion ribs; no colored shells or coplanar tiles. Eight coarse uneven bands, not dozens of BIF laminae. Avoid treating the crosscutting pale veins in supplemental USGS DeathValley photo as foliation.
repair_design: Actual r001 hero/top/clay inspected: folded physical bands present but top blank and too smooth. r002 adds integrated triangulated broken top with coarse mineral band regions and surface relief, rougher natural side silhouette; single shared-vertex shell, no overlays.
